beats.say: This Dhanteras, India paid about twelve percent more for the same gold.
Jewellers estimate sixty thousand crore in sales. Up fifteen to twenty percent in value, flat in volume.
Ten grams cost one lakh forty-eight thousand eight hundred in Delhi. Last Dhanteras? One lakh thirty-two thousand four hundred.
lines: Incl. taxes, All India Sarafa Association

beats.say: Wait, it gets better. That's still nineteen percent below January's record. That dip pulled buyers back.
lines: of ₹1,83,000. The dip pulled buyers back.

beats.say: Zoom out. July to September, jewellery demand fell twenty percent by weight, but rose sixteen percent by value.
India isn't buying more gold. It's paying more for it. Send this to whoever bought gold this year, and follow for more.
lines: Send this to whoever bought gold this year.
